whatItIs.statement: An interactive component which expands or collapses a panel.

whenToUse.statement: Use Collapsible when secondary content or settings should be revealed on demand without navigating away.

howToUse.statement: Compose Collapsible with CollapsibleTrigger and CollapsibleContent; the trigger and content must remain inside the same Collapsible root.
Use open with onOpenChange for controlled state, or defaultOpen for an uncontrolled initial state.

options.statement: Use disabled on Collapsible to disable the disclosure interaction.
Use forceMount on CollapsibleContent when the content must remain mounted for animation or integration needs.
